_comment: WHOOP 4.0 RAW IMU ORACLE. What the Swift decoder (Whoop4RawImu.accel, Packages/WhoopProtocol) returns
for each frame below: 'accel' is null where it refuses the frame, otherwise the timestamp, subseconds
and the three 100-sample axes it read. Whoop4RawImuTest.kt asserts the Kotlin twin gives the same.
Generated by running the Swift decoder itself over these bytes; no generator is retained in this
repository, and there is no Swift copy of this file. Do not hand-edit an 'accel' value.
corpus_imu is the one 1928-byte packet of the parity corpus (frames.json). The varied_* frames are
that packet with every byte from the timestamp to the trailer replaced by pseudo-random bytes and a
run of edge sample values (0x8000, 0x7FFF, 0xFFFF, ...) written into each axis, then re-sealed with
valid checksums: the corpus packet alone holds constant axes (0, 0, 4096), which neither tell X
from Y nor exercise the sign of a sample.
